speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and abdominal lymphadenopathy, in the absence of infection or HIV, strongly points to this malignancy. A biopsy of the supraclavicular node is required for confirmation.
